summary: Gyldendal A/S publishes and sells books in Denmark and Norway. It publishes fiction books, including novels, entertainment literature, crime, classics, poems, short stories, children's, young adult, romance and eroticism, and other fiction books; and non-fiction books, such as biographies, history, society and politics, cookbooks, sports, health and fitness, spirituality, business, art, culture and design, gardening, hobbies and needlework, nature, science, and other fiction books. The company also provides tutoring services; produces teaching materials; and operates reading club. Gyldendal A/S was founded in 1770 and is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.
